span.p:
Read remaining_calories (rc) & remaining_protein (rp)
from NutritionState (or explicit hypothetical override)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compute min_kcal = max(80, 0.35 * min(rc, 600))
_options_by_role(diet, avoid, rc):
Filter get_food_db(user_id) by diet_allows() & avoid list
Expand portion LADDERS where item calories <= rc

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Generate Cartesian products across 12 TEMPLATES:
(protein), (protein+carb), (protein+veg), (protein+carb+veg),
(legume+carb), (dairy+fruit), (other/custom), etc.
Keep combinations with min_kcal <= kcal <= rc

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Score each combo via _score(meal, rc, rp, prefer)
Diversify via _diverse(MAX_PER_MAIN_FOOD=4)
Reserve up to MAX_OWN_FOODS=5 user custom foods
Store in ephemeral ctx.state.pool['candidates'] as c01..c35

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 2: estimate_meal_nutrition(ctx, candidate_ids)
Recompute calories, protein, carbs, fat from DB via _recalculate()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 3: rank_meal_candidates(ctx, top_n=5)
Compute weighted score:
• 0.50 * protein_score (meal protein vs proportional protein_share)
• 0.25 * calorie_fill (1 - |meal_kcal - min(rc,600)| / min(rc,600))
• 0.15 * variety (1.0 for 2+ foods, 0.6 for single food)
• 0.10 * preference (1.0 if any item in prefer list)
Apply _diverse() & attach human-readable _reason()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Step 4: validate_recommendation_fit(ctx, candidate_id)
Re-resolve items from scratch against DB
Verify |stored_estimate - fresh_meal| <= 0.05
Verify fresh_meal.calories <= remaining_calories

span.p:
Append to pool['validated'] & persist via
ctx.state.set_recommendations() into data/users/.json
